title: Chaotic World
description: Enjoy the Final moments of your World with this Data pack.
body:
### **THE CHAOTIC WORLD:**

Made with the help of [misode](https://misode.github.io/).


### **INFOS:**
   [**_CurseForge_**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/chaotic-world-nobie)  ![CurseForge Downloads](https://img.shields.io/curseforge/dt/1554514?style=plastic&color=d55c0b&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.curseforge.com%2Fminecraft%2Fmc-mods%2Fchaotic-world-nobie)
   [_**Modrinth**_](https://modrinth.com/datapack/chaotic-world/versions)![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/hhesnqPt?style=plastic&color=g&link=https%3A%2F%2Fmodrinth.com%2Fdatapack%2Fchaotic-world)


![Cool GIF](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bbeca8c5422171fbde089b3984b7595a363ef1a7.gif)

I made this mod just for _fun_ while experimenting with the world genertion settings.
What this mod do is **3 things:**
- Changing the lowest limit for generating the world to 0 (_structures such as Trial Chambers still generate under bedrock_). 
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

![Bedrock Level](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/81ab160110afdcc52853f09405b4e1cb40bcb40b.gif)
</details>


- Changing the SEA level to 10.
- Changing the scale and size of biomes to 1. 
 
 ![Horizen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1642805da2cc12d672b9809936115df7dcaae795.gif)


### **COMPATIBILITY:**

- This mod is compatible whit the fast world generation mod [C2M](https://modrinth.com/mod/c2me-fabric) and doesn't change the surface at all
- Currently, this mod has no config settings (_will be added soon_), and show up with name search (_just  scroll all the way down and you'll find the mod there_)

<summary>Spoiler</summary>
  
![Mod Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/173c54a76bd7c306047f9dd3a0027a67ab7d5357_0.webp)
</details>
